summary: @or-sdk/lookup preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle using a rotating string array (`WV8StW`), hex-scrambled identifiers, and `with`-statement anti-analysis constructs that defeat standard AST tooling. The package advertises a Weaviate-backed Q&A/lookup SDK; downloading a second language runtime at npm install time solely to execute a heavily obfuscated bundle is unrelated to that purpose and results in arbitrary attacker-controlled code executing on the installer's host during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
